 Experience ultimate relaxation with our Sauna Tent Rental
This portable, cozy sauna tent offers the perfect way to unwind in nature or your own backyard. With soothing heat, a serene atmosphere, and easy setup, it’s an ideal escape for solo relaxation or a group wellness session. Enjoy the benefits of a sauna in a unique, convenient setting—perfect for any outdoor retreat or peaceful getaway!

Highlights
Picture this!

Riding E-bikes through picturesque Cave Point County Park and setting up your Sauna Tent on the beach at iconic Whitefish Dunes State Park. The sun is shining, air is crisp. You spend your day soaking up all the therapeutic benefits of a Sauna, maybe you take a cold plunge in Lake Michigan! Pack a picnic, bring some blankets, make it a day to never forget!

 What's included

 What's not included

We supply 1 bundle of wood and so you may need to prepare to have more wood on hand for the length of your rental. You can purchase more from us ahead of time.

Towels not included.

Add ons not included.
